notes.title: Development Update September 2025
notes.notes:
Hello all, it's been a busy few weeks. I'm happy to report that all boss characters are finished and I've now moved onto putting some puzzles together to give you a break from all the horror. I'm balancing this with giving our main character a sprucing up. Excited to show you this in the next updated. Thanks for your support. Here's some more boss art (spoilers!). Can you figure out what British folklore inspired this character?

notes.title: Development Update August 2025
notes.notes:
A warm August hello to everyone! The weather might still be toasty here in the UK, but development on From Fire is just as hot. Over the past few weeks, I’ve been diving deep into the final stages of the boss character. The mechanics are proving to be quite involved but I'm having fun implementing my vision. I'm also investigating the possibility of updating our main character Sgt. Aaron to give him more fidelity. Watch this space! Thanks so much for following the journey—hope you’re enjoying the rest of your summer! Oh and here's some promo boss art I put together, spoilers ahead :)

[spoiler]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021673/c8a3c873f9204be29c8ac3c20385ea904e316203.png[/img]

[/spoilers]

notes.title: Development Update July 2025
notes.notes: [p]A big July greeting to you all! Developing in a British heatwave has its challenges but it will not deter me :). This past month, I’ve been working hard on the remaining boss character. The model and texturing is done. The animation, programming and mechanics continue. This boss plays a huge role in From Fire, and I want it to be something players remember (and maybe have nightmares about) for a long time. Have a great summer and thank you for your support.[/p]

notes.title: Development Update June 2025
notes.notes: [p]Happy June everyone! A quick update on what I've been up to. Boss fights have been the focus recently and will be the focus for the next few weeks as well. The good news is that there’s only one boss left to do and the model for it is already finished. I’m really pleased with how these battles have turned out, given how ambitious they were. The remaining boss is no different and I’ve been looking forward to working on this one for a very long time. The concept for this boss was first created in my mind ever since I played ‘Zombies Ate My Neighbors’ on the SNES. I am thrilled that I can now make that idea a reality and get it into your hands. As always thanks for all the support and motivation you give me![/p]

notes.title: Development Update May 2025
notes.notes: Hey horror fans, here’s what I’ve been up to this May. I've mostly spent time designing and implementing boss characters of the game. I'm trying to ensure the bosses have some depth to them and remain faithful to English folklore source material. They'll have their own story that you, the player, will be a part of. I really hope you enjoy fighting these guys in the battles I'm crafting for you!

notes.title: Development Update April 2025
notes.notes:
Hey horror fans, here’s what I’ve been up to this April. Time had been mostly spent finishing the enemy characters that you will face in the game. I really hope you enjoy fighting (or avoiding) them! The next piece of work I've moved onto is creating boss characters.  Suffice to say [b]huge spoilers[/b] ahead so do not reveal if you would prefer waiting to experience these enemies in-game. For the more curious out there, the next bit is for you.
[spoiler] Here are the creatures and demons that await you. If you haven't already, wishlist now!

notes.title: Development Update March 2025
notes.notes: I'm deep in development focusing on key characters. I'm putting a lot of effort into creating these characters and given recent feedback to avoid spoilers, I won't post them here so you all get to experience them for the first time in game. Things are moving along and I want updates like this to give you an idea of the general area I'm working on and to assure you that progress is being made!

notes.title: Enemy Added: Slayer
notes.notes:
[spoiler]
The Slayer is a nightmarish enemy that prowls the forest. With a massive blade for an arm, moving deceptively fast for its size, it strikes silently from the shadows, hunting unsuspecting prey with brutal precision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021673/dc7baf60db3bd6c72567eca8708ffab97a1040e7.png[/img]
[/spoiler]

notes.title: Enemy Added: Ghoul
notes.notes:
[spoiler]
The Ghoul is a horrifying, undead creature that prowls graveyards and dark, abandoned places. With pale, decaying skin and an insatiable hunger for human flesh, it feeds on the living and the dead. It lurks in the shadows waiting to strike with its razor sharp teeth and claws.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021673/128040b9b5434e7a41b87e00be4d5b8f561b725e.png[/img]
[/spoiler]

notes.title: Enemy Added: Demon Werewolf
notes.notes:
[spoiler]
A demon possessed werewolf that is a twisted creature of rage and darkness. Its fur is dark as the night, and its eyes glow red. Its claws are sharp as obsidian, its growls deep and unnatural. The demon amplifies its hunger and brutality, turning it into a savage, soulless monster. Able to close distance very quickly via a leaping attack and then finish the job with relentless claw attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021673/bcd4181e5756d324d08f03e49bf6aad7bf275e75.png[/img]
[/spoiler]

notes.title: Enemy Added: Rive
notes.notes:
[spoiler]
An insane demon, driven by unfathomable rage and madness. Using the saw implanted in its head, sawed off its own hands in a brutal display of self-destruction. Now, with jagged stumps but a razor sharp head saw, it prowls the countryside looking for victims. Its disfigured form mirrors its fractured mind, a terrifying embodiment of chaos and torment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021673/cafd8cfb35457c6d87c7445ddcb45808f1756766.png[/img]
[/spoiler]

notes.title: Double Barrel Shotgun Added
notes.notes:
This 12-gauge, twin-trigger, double barrel shotgun features two smoothbore barrels, enabling quick successive shots, making it ideal for hunting purposes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021673/19a1937190e1c982ec44f4e4db344d17c5c91b0b.png[/img]

notes.title: Grenade Launcher Added
notes.notes:
Meet the LEYTON-10 grenade launcher. A single-fire grenade launcher designed for precision and impact, firing explosive rounds with reliable performance. Deals devastating damage to an area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021673/7a9c89d6405f6e326545feee04e99886a54d79ab.png[/img]

notes.title: Assault Rifle Added
notes.notes:
Meet the STOW-17 assault rifle. A neglected but working assault rifle with a 25-round magazine. It boasts good accuracy, range and versatility, making it effective in a variety of combat situations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021673/5318fa40c65a7a16738b8226b86588617001a433.png[/img]

notes.title: From Fire Emergence Playable Demo - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Play a 20-30 minute demo of the game to experience the mechanics and core systems of From Fire Emergence.

Available to download now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2989930/From_Fire_Emergence/

I've strived to make this demo as polished and bug free as possible so you get the most genuine experience I intended players to have. I hope you enjoy the atmosphere, exploration, puzzle solving and combat.

It's a really exciting time to have you all experience the demo and I hope you enjoy it! If you have any feedback, feel free to let me know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2989930/discussions/0/4416424085347737324/]discussion [/url] forum.

Cheers,
Grizzled Markhor
